Editor.title: Title
Editor.description_placeholder: A Sunday chicken that cooks itself — one dish, one hour in the oven.
Editor.ingredients_placeholder:
- 1 whole chicken
- 1 lemon
- 4 sprigs of thyme
- 3 cloves of garlic
- 2 spoons of olive oil
Editor.instructions_placeholder:
Prep
- Heat the oven to 200°C
- Halve the lemon and slip it inside the chicken with the thyme

Roast
- Rub the chicken with the oil, salt and pepper
- Roast for 1 hour 15, basting halfway through
> Tilt the tray to gather the juices
- Rest for 10 minutes before carving
